items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: they all used to play together. All of them played together

ctx.x: Charlie Christian was one who is the greatest jazz guitarists I've heard, but Oscar Ellman, he would have excited Charlie Christian. Even from listening to Oscar Ellman and Oscar Ellman would have been listening to him too, so, they would, they would like each other very much.

So, and Djang, Djang, well, Djang was there and Tango had, he was, he had a problem as we all have heard about. But he could find what he was missing in his physical incapacity because he had mentally -- he would come to a passage
that he knew it meant a lot of execution, but he would find a note as you would call a oul note, which would equal twenty notes to the other person's one.
